name: Connections - Enhanced Connection Collaboration Model
description: To enhance security, we aim to prevent the sharing of Microsoft account credentials across collaborators. The new connection-sharing model will encourage each collaborator to sign in with their own Microsoft account.

result.descriptionEs: Para reforzar la seguridad, el nuevo modelo para compartir conexiones evitará compartir credenciales de cuentas de Microsoft: cada colaborador iniciará sesión con su propia cuenta.
